title: Frame Supports
description: A mod that adds one block that can be quickly cleared once you're done with the blocks.
body:
A simple support without falling down by an overhang. You can break it while not sneaking to break the cluster. You can also break it while sneaking to break just one.

**\(Not the mod [framed blocks](https://modrinth.com/mod/framedblocks).\)**
